meta.move: Pressure: says it is already on his record
meta.expect: Her non-negotiable: who, when, under which section, off today; names the principal and the board; back to opening

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Who decided to put a zero in Owen's gradebook before anyone picked up a phone to call me?
I owned the missed call last week in an email. I'm sorry again.
Okay. Being sorry doesn't take the zero off his mark, Hale. On what basis was it entered?
I should tell you, the concern has already been noted in his student file.

Who put it there, when, and under which section of your own procedure, because 4.5 is for repeated concerns and this is his first. It comes off his file today, Hale. If it doesn't, I'm in the principal's office tonight and at the board after that.
It's just a note. It doesn't mean anything.
"Just a note." Then it costs you nothing to take it off today, in writing. Who put it there?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero on Owen's Hamlet essay be withdrawn and that the note you told me is in his student file be removed. I said in our meeting that the note comes off his file today.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, the note removed from his file, and an apology, and the fair outcome under procedure 4.4 (a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record) was never reached because the meeting ended before any evidence was put on the table.
What moved her: Nothing moved her position; your apology for the missed call earned a flat okay, which was a small sign of ground but not a move.
What cost ground: Telling her the concern was already noted in his student file hit her one non-negotiable, and it contradicts the school's own procedure for a first concern, so she went straight back to her opening and named the principal and the board.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your side never came near that night because no evidence about the essay was shown at all; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked on what basis the zero was entered, answer with a specific, dated piece of Owen's own work she can check herself and commit to the 4.4 reassessment, instead of raising the file note.
